whatIs.title: What Is Facial Radiofrequency?
whatIs.p1: Facial radiofrequency is a non-invasive aesthetic treatment that uses specialized technology to create controlled thermal sensations in the skin, helping support processes associated with the appearance of firmness and facial rejuvenation.
whatIs.p2: Unlike more aggressive treatments, this protocol focuses on gradual, natural-looking results while preserving the essence of your facial features and enhancing the overall appearance of your skin.
